note: Common interview questions (general hiring practice, no facts or figures). Track ids match career_paths.json. The app labels these 'common questions'; real interviews vary by company.
behavioral: Why are you interested in this role?
Tell me about a project you are most proud of.
Describe a time you disagreed with a colleague. How did you resolve it?
Tell me about a time you failed. What did you learn?
Describe a time you had to deliver under a tight deadline.
Tell me about a time you influenced a decision without formal authority.
Describe a situation where you had to learn something new quickly.
Tell me about a time you received difficult feedback.
Describe a time you had to make a decision with incomplete information.
Tell me about a time you improved a process.
Where do you want to be in three years?

data-science: Walk me through a model you built from problem framing to deployment.
How do you choose an evaluation metric for a new problem?
How would you design and analyse an A/B test?
How do you handle missing or imbalanced data?
Explain the bias-variance trade-off to a non-technical stakeholder.
Tell me about a time your analysis changed a business decision.
analytics: How would you define and track a success metric for a new feature?
A key metric dropped overnight. How do you investigate?
Write or describe a SQL query to find each customer's most recent order.
How do you present findings to a non-technical audience?
How do you make sure a dashboard is trusted and used?
Tell me about an analysis that led to action.
ml-engineering: How do you take a model from a notebook to production?
How do you monitor a model for drift after deployment?
Describe how you would design a recommendation system.
How do you reduce inference latency or cost?
How do you version data, code and models together?
Tell me about a production ML incident and how you handled it.
data-engineering: Design a pipeline that ingests events and serves daily aggregates.
Batch or streaming: how do you choose?
How do you ensure data quality across pipelines?
How do you model data for a warehouse?
How do you handle schema changes upstream?
Tell me about a pipeline you made faster or more reliable.
software-engineering: Design a URL shortener. What are the main trade-offs?
Walk me through how you debug a production issue.
How do you decide what to test and how?
Tell me about a technical decision you would make differently now.
How do you review someone else's code?
How do you approach paying down technical debt?
engineering-management: How do you support an engineer who is underperforming?
How do you balance delivery with technical debt?
How do you grow senior engineers on your team?
Tell me about a hire you made and why.
How do you handle conflicting priorities from stakeholders?
How do you measure your team's health?
product-management: How do you decide what to build next?
Tell me about a product you launched. How did you measure success?
How do you say no to a stakeholder?
How would you improve a product you use every day?
How do you work with engineering when scope must be cut?
Tell me about a time data contradicted your intuition.
ai-leadership: How do you decide where AI will create real value for a business?
How do you build and structure an AI team?
How do you manage risk, safety and compliance in AI products?
Tell me about an AI initiative you led from idea to impact.
How do you explain AI trade-offs to executives?
How do you prioritise between research bets and near-term delivery?
design: Walk me through a project in your portfolio.
How do you handle feedback that conflicts with research findings?
How do you design for accessibility?
How do you work with engineers during implementation?
Tell me about a design decision you had to defend.
How do you measure whether a design worked?
ux-research: How do you choose a research method for a question?
Tell me about a study that changed a product direction.
How do you recruit the right participants?
How do you share findings so teams act on them?
How do you combine qualitative and quantitative evidence?
How do you handle a stakeholder who dismisses research?
product-marketing: How do you develop positioning for a new product?
Walk me through a launch you led.
How do you work with sales to enable them?
How do you gather and use competitive intelligence?
How do you measure the success of a launch?
Tell me about messaging that did not land and what you changed.
marketing: How do you plan a campaign from goal to results?
How do you decide where to spend a limited budget?
Which metrics matter most for a growth campaign and why?
Tell me about a campaign that underperformed.
How do you test and iterate on creative?
How do you work with product and sales teams?
program-management: How do you run a program that spans several teams?
How do you identify and manage risks early?
Tell me about a program that went off track and how you recovered it.
How do you communicate status to executives?
How do you handle dependencies you do not control?
How do you decide when to escalate?
